import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, itertools

BM=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in """4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".split('\n')],float)
GO,GE=-11.,-1.
def oh(p):
    C=np.zeros((len(p[0]),20))
    for s in p:
        for i,c in enumerate(s):
            if c in AI: C[i,AI[c]]+=1
    return C
def al(P,Q):
    CP,CQ=oh(P),oh(Q); den=np.outer(CP.sum(1),CQ.sum(1)); den[den==0]=1
    S=(CP@BM@CQ.T)/den; m,n=len(P[0]),len(Q[0]); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((m+1,n+1),NEG);Ix=M.copy();Iy=M.copy();tb=np.zeros((m+1,n+1,3),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    Ix[1:,0]=GO+GE*(np.arange(1,m+1)-1); tb[1:,0,1]=1
    Iy[0,1:]=GO+GE*(np.arange(1,n+1)-1); tb[0,1:,2]=2
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        M0,X0,Y0=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        st=np.stack([M0[:-1],X0[:-1],Y0[:-1]]);k=st.argmax(0);M[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)]+S[i-1];tb[i,1:,0]=k
        st=np.stack([M0[1:]+GO,X0[1:]+GE,Y0[1:]+GO]);k=st.argmax(0);Ix[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(n)];tb[i,1:,1]=k
        Mi,Xi,Yi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            v=(Mi[j-1]+GO,Xi[j-1]+GO,Yi[j-1]+GE);kk=int(np.argmax(v));Yi[j]=v[kk];tb[i,j,2]=kk
    i,j=m,n;st=int(np.argmax([M[m,n],Ix[m,n],Iy[m,n]]));pa=[];qa=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);i-=1;continue
        if st==0: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: pa.append(i-1);qa.append(None);ns=tb[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: pa.append(None);qa.append(j-1);ns=tb[i,j,2];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
    pa.reverse();qa.reverse()
    return [''.join(p[k] if k is not None else '-' for k in pa) for p in P]+[''.join(q[k] if k is not None else '-' for k in qa) for q in Q]
def fetch(a): return ''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
SEQ={k:fetch(v) for k,v in {'Yet1':'P35723','Yet2':'Q04210','Yet3':'Q07451','BAP29':'Q9UHQ4','BAP31':'P51572'}.items()}
FIN=al(al([SEQ['BAP29']],[SEQ['BAP31']]), al(al([SEQ['Yet1']],[SEQ['Yet2']]),[SEQ['Yet3']]))
MSA=dict(zip(['BAP29','BAP31','Yet1','Yet2','Yet3'],FIN))
cm={};c=0
for i,ch in enumerate(MSA['BAP31']):
    if ch!='-': c+=1; cm[c]=i
# g<->e' pairs in BAP31 numbering (parallel dimer: g(i) of chain1 with e(i+1) of chain2, 5 apart)
GEP=[(173,178),(180,185),(187,192),(194,199),(201,206),(208,213)]
CHG={'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.5,'D':-1,'E':-1}
def ge_score(X,Y):
    """g of X with e' of Y plus g of Y with e' of X, over aligned columns."""
    tot=0; det=[]
    for (g,e) in GEP:
        for A,Bn in ((X,Y),(Y,X)):
            ga=MSA[A][cm[g]]; eb=MSA[Bn][cm[e]]
            if ga=='-' or eb=='-': continue
            q=CHG.get(ga,0)*CHG.get(eb,0)
            tot+= -q      # opposite charges (q<0) -> favourable, score +1
            det.append((A,ga,g,Bn,eb,e,-q))
    return tot,det
names=['BAP31','BAP29','Yet1','Yet2','Yet3']
Mge=np.zeros((5,5))
for i,x in enumerate(names):
    for j,y in enumerate(names):
        Mge[i,j]=ge_score(x,y)[0]
print("g<->e' electrostatic pairing score (parallel dimer register, + favourable):")
print(pd.DataFrame(Mge,index=names,columns=names).to_string())
# core a/d hydrophobic complementarity (sum BLOSUM of paired core residues, both chains)
A31=[174,181,188,195,202,209,216]; D31=[170,177,184,191,198,205,212]
def core_pack(X,Y):
    s=0;n=0
    for p in A31+D31:
        a=MSA[X][cm[p]]; b=MSA[Y][cm[p]]
        if a=='-' or b=='-': continue
        s+=BM[AI[a],AI[b]]; n+=1
    return s/n if n else np.nan, n
print("\nCore a/d packing complementarity (mean BLOSUM62 of residues facing each other, n positions shared):")
Mc=np.full((5,5),np.nan); Nn=np.zeros((5,5),int)
for i,x in enumerate(names):
    for j,y in enumerate(names):
        Mc[i,j],Nn[i,j]=core_pack(x,y)
print(pd.DataFrame(Mc.round(2),index=names,columns=names).to_string())
print("\nshared core positions n:"); print(pd.DataFrame(Nn,index=names,columns=names).to_string())
print("\nYet2 homodimer g/e' detail:", ge_score('Yet2','Yet2')[1])
print("Yet2-Yet1 g/e' detail:", ge_score('Yet2','Yet1')[1])
print("Yet1-Yet3 g/e' detail:", ge_score('Yet1','Yet3')[1])
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,5))
for ax,Mx,t,cmp_ in [(axs[0],Mge,"g$\\leftrightarrow$e' electrostatic pairing score\n(+ favourable, - repulsive)",'RdBu_r'),
                     (axs[1],Mc,'core a/d packing complementarity\n(mean BLOSUM62 of facing residues)','viridis')]:
    im=ax.imshow(Mx,cmap=cmp_ if cmp_!='RdBu_r' else 'RdBu',vmin=np.nanmin(Mx),vmax=np.nanmax(Mx))
    ax.set_xticks(range(5));ax.set_xticklabels(names,rotation=30);ax.set_yticks(range(5));ax.set_yticklabels(names)
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            if not np.isnan(Mx[i,j]): ax.text(j,i,f"{Mx[i,j]:.2f}" if cmp_=='viridis' else f"{Mx[i,j]:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,color='k')
    ax.set_title(t,fontsize=10); plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.045)
plt.suptitle('Predicted parallel coiled-coil pairing preference across the BAP31 family',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
